Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Norris Bradbury directed the Los Alamos effort that developed the first atomic bomb, conflating Bradbury’s postwar directorship (beginning after Trinity/late 1945) with the wartime period. The correct US physicist who directed Los Alamos during the development/testing of the first atomic bomb (1942–1945) was J. Robert Oppenheimer, which also aligns with Feynman’s “Water Boiler” work at Los Alamos.
